title: Removed Entries
body: Removed the Entries feature, as it wasn’t very useful. Lickety Add still keeps your last entry available with Up Arrow.

title: Words Left at a glance
body: Moved the Words Left count to the right, with a rainbow level and changing colours to show completion.

title: 42 surprise celebrations
body: Enjoy new celebrations, with future effects delivered automatically. Play again repeats the celebration you just saw.

title: Clearer personal progress
body: Past unfinished puzzles are now marked Incomplete in red.

title: Copy today’s progress
body: Copy today’s puzzle letters, found words and progress in one summary.

title: Quieter update recovery
body: Temporary update failures retry quietly. Routine offline failures stay quiet too.
